info.title: Gregmorn Hub API
info.description:
Gregmorn Hub API v1.0 — Integration Guide.

## Environments
- Stage and Prod are separate: **logins**, **secret keys**, **IP allowlists**.
- Start on **Stage**. Move to **Prod** only after acceptance.

## Required before start
- Callback URL for seamless wallet callbacks.
- IPs for allowlisting: separate lists for Stage and Prod.
- Stage currency list. Callback URLs are configured **per currency**.

## Integration models
- **Seamless**: provider calls your wallet (`getBalance`, `writeBet`, `rollback`) with `X-Signature`.
- **Transfer**: merchant calls `POST /apiIndividualWallet/` (`userCreate`, `userCash`, `userInfo`). No callbacks.

tags.name: Game Catalog
tags.description: Fetch available games for the user.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Seamless wallet callbacks: provider → merchant.

- Every callback must include `X-Signature`.
- Signature: HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body.
- Use `transactionId` as the idempotency key.
- Duplicate successful `writeBet`: return current balance, do not apply again.

> **IMPORTANT:** if `getBalance` returns HTTP 400, do not start the spin. Do not use default or cached balance.

tags.name: Transfer Wallet
tags.description:
Transfer wallet: merchant → Gregmorn Hub.

- Endpoint: `POST /apiIndividualWallet/`
- Wallet commands: `userCreate`, `userCash`, `userInfo`
- Report commands: `reportBet`, `sessionList`, `sessionLog`
- Signing: same `X-Signature` flow as `openGame` and webhooks.

tags.name: Free Spins
tags.description:
Free spins: merchant → Gregmorn Hub.

- Endpoint: `POST /games/freespinsInfo`
- Signing: same `X-Signature` flow as `openGame` and webhooks.
- To start a free-spin session, pass `freespinTotalBet` and `freespinCount` to `POST /games/openGame` after a successful eligibility check.

info.description: Bet and win details from providers.

cmd.description:
Transfer wallet or report command.
- `userCreate` creates a player wallet.
- `userCash` changes the player balance.
- `userInfo` returns the current player balance.
- `reportBet` returns aggregated bet/win statistics for one day.
- `sessionList` returns game sessions for the requested date range.
- `sessionLog` returns spin-by-spin details for one session.

user_login.description: Player login within the merchant hall. Required for `userCreate`, `userCash`, `userInfo`; optional filter for `sessionList`.

user_id.description: User identifier used to resolve `secret_api_key` for signature validation.

currency.description: Wallet currency for `userCreate`, `userCash`, and `userInfo`. Defaults to `USD`.

operation.description: Required for `userCash`: `in` deposits money, `out` withdraws money.

post.description:
Single entry point for transfer wallet operations.

Required base fields: `cmd`, `user_id`.

Commands:
- `userCreate`: create player wallet.
- `userCash`: change balance (`operation = in|out`).
- `userInfo`: return current balance.
- `reportBet`: return aggregated bet/win statistics for one day.
- `sessionList`: return game sessions for the requested date range.
- `sessionLog`: return spin-by-spin details for one session.

Signing:
- Header: `X-Signature`
- Secret: player-specific `secret_api_key` by `user_id`
- Payload: exact raw JSON body bytes
- Algorithm: HMAC-SHA256, hex digest

`user_login` is required for `userCreate`, `userCash`, `userInfo` and can be used as an optional filter for `sessionList`.
`currency` selects the player wallet currency for `userCreate`, `userCash`, `userInfo`; default is `USD`.
`userCash.cash` must be a decimal string with up to 2 fractional digits.
Report commands use the same signature model and can request only the last 10 days.
Report totals are calculated from `writeBet` transactions and adjusted by `rollback` transactions.

Login endpoint.

Request:
- URL: `POST https://office-api-dev.helcenac.com/auth/login`
- Content-Type: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
- Body fields: `login`, `password`

> **IMPORTANT:** `accessToken` has limited TTL. After expiry, call `/auth/login` again.

> **COMMON ERROR:** do not send JSON here. Use `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, otherwise expect HTTP 400 or 401.

Open game session.

- Requires `X-Signature` over raw JSON body.
- `demo = "1"`: demo mode, no wallet callbacks.
- `demo = "0"`: real gameplay.
- `callbackUrl`: optional override for the admin-panel callback URL.
- `ip`: optional player IP. Required only for some providers; ask support if your provider requires it.
- Before assigning free spins, call `POST /games/freespinsInfo` to get the game's free-spin information.

real_mode.summary: Real mode with explicit callback URL

post.summary: Get free-spin limits for a game
post.description:
Check whether a game supports free spins for the selected currency before opening a free-spin session.

- `code: 0`: the game supports free spins. Use `availableBets` and `maxCount` to form the subsequent `POST /games/openGame` request.
- `code: 1`: the game does not support free spins; do not start a free-spin session.
- `code: 9`: the provider returned an error; inspect `message` and retry only after resolving it.

An empty `availableBets` array means that every bet amount is allowed. `maxCount: 0` means that the number of free spins is unlimited.

supported_with_limits.summary: Free spins supported with a bet and count limit

supported_without_limits.summary: Any bet amount and count are supported

not_supported.summary: Free spins are unavailable for this game

post.description:
Provider asks for current player balance.

- Requires `X-Signature`.
- Return HTTP 200 + `status: "success"` only when balance is confirmed.

> **IMPORTANT:** HTTP 400 means `Fail / retry`. Do not start the spin. Do not use default or cached balance.

success.summary: Session is valid and balance is returned

post.description:
Apply bet/win to merchant wallet.

Rules:
- Accept: HTTP **2xx** + `status: "success"`.
- Reject: HTTP **400+** + `status: "fail"`.
- Idempotency key: `transactionId`.
- Duplicate successful `transactionId`: return HTTP **200**, current balance, do not apply again.

> **IMPORTANT:** if player balance is insufficient for the bet, reject `writeBet`. Providers do not calculate or reserve funds using `getBalance`.

> **IMPORTANT:** successful response `balance` must be **after** applying the operation, not before.

bet_and_win_together.summary: Bet and win in a single callback (some providers)

after_bet_and_win.summary: Bet and win applied in a single callback

post.description:
Roll back the original bet.

- `transactionId` must match the original bet transaction ID.
- Restore balance only once.
